EP01:E29 8900-10300 LADY JULIANA: "No..."
EP01:E30 11100-14000 CAMERA: Wide profile shot showing Juliana standing below the altar platform, looking up at Gerald and her sister.
EP01:E32 14000-17200 LADY JULIANA: "You knew this before I walked through those doors!"

EP01:E34 19200-21800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's hands desperately clenching fistfuls of her white dress fabric.
EP01:E35 20000-21800 LADY JULIANA: "You let me come here..."
EP01:E36 21800-24800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes with grief.
EP01:E37 21900-24100 LADY JULIANA: "You let me dress in my mother's gown..."
EP01:E38 24200-27200 LADY JULIANA: "You let me believe I was walking toward my husband!"
EP01:E39 24800-27300 CAMERA: Medium shot on Gerald stepping forward, cold and indifferent, with the Lady in Gold Gown lingering in soft focus behind him.
EP01:E41 27300-29000 THE FORMER GROOM: "I changed my mind."

EP01:E42 30200-33200 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's furious, weeping face.
EP01:E43 30600-32800 LADY JULIANA: "You swore you loved me!"
EP01:E44 33200-36000 CAMERA: Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown smiling condescendingly.
EP01:E45 33700-36000 LADY IN GOLD GOWN: "People change their minds, sister."
EP01:E46 36000-39600 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of the Lady in Gold Gown turning her head subtly toward Gerald with satisfied malice.
EP01:E47 36300-37600 LADY JULIANA: "And you knew?"
EP01:E48 37800-39300 LADY IN GOLD GOWN: "Of course I knew."
EP01:E49 39600-41800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, stunned by the callous depth of the conspiracy.
EP01:E50 40300-41500 LADY JULIANA: "How long?"
EP01:E51 41800-46200 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of the Lady in Gold Gown and Gerald looking together down at Juliana.
EP01:E52 42200-45700 LADY IN GOLD GOWN: "Long enough to know he was never going to marry you."
EP01:E53 46200-48200 ACTION: Juliana turns abruptly toward the first row of pews, where her elderly father sits gripping an ornate brass cane.
EP01:E54 46200-48600 CAMERA: Close-up on the father's hand tightly gripping the gold curved handle of his walking cane.
EP01:E55 47300-48400 LADY JULIANA: "Father..."
EP01:E57 48600-50800 LADY JULIANA: "Tell them this is a mistake."
